resource-bright.name: Gentle Puppy
resource-bright.who: Someone warm who steps forward to check on you
resource-bright.look: Round, soft-cornered eyes with an open smile and a gentle jawline stand out first.
resource-bright.ease: Even when words do not come easily, their eyes check on you first, easing the tension around you.
resource-bright.care: Looking after others is a habit, so their own needs easily slip behind. It helps to say thank you often.

resource-quiet.name: Gentle Deer
resource-quiet.who: Someone who stays quietly by your side, watching over you
resource-quiet.look: Clear, wide eyes, a slender face, and a calm, quiet gaze leave a lasting impression.
resource-quiet.ease: They tend not to rush you, giving you space and time to sort through your thoughts.
resource-quiet.care: Their easy pace means decisions can get pushed back. Agreeing on a date together helps for anything important.

power-bright.name: Crisp and Defined
power-bright.who: Someone who sets a direction and leads the way
power-bright.look: Distinct eyelids, defined brows, a deep gaze, and a prominent bridge catch your eye at once.
power-bright.ease: They point the way at crossroads, giving you something steady to lean on when you hesitate.
power-bright.care: Because their boundaries are firm, their tone can sound blunt. Clearing up little hurts before the day ends tends to work best.

power-quiet.name: Clean and Mild
power-quiet.who: Someone reliable who supports you from behind
power-quiet.look: Uncluttered, understated features with straight brows give off an orderly, calm look.
power-quiet.ease: They keep commitments without making a fuss, making it easy to relax the longer you know them.
power-quiet.care: Since they show very little on the surface, reading their mood can take effort. It helps to put your gratitude into words.

output-bright.name: Feline Spark
output-bright.who: Someone who brightens any gathering with quick wit
output-bright.look: Slightly upturned outer corners of the eyes and a playful smirk give this face its signature look.
output-bright.ease: Conversation rarely runs dry with them, and awkward moments soften without effort.
output-bright.care: Their moods shift quickly, which can make plans seem casual. Double-checking important dates keeps things clear.

output-quiet.name: Sleek Fox
output-quiet.who: Someone of few words with deep emotional resonance
output-quiet.look: Long, sleek eyes, a slender jaw, and a cool, observant presence set the tone.
output-quiet.ease: Even brief remarks hold genuine weight, leaving quiet conversations that linger with you.
output-quiet.care: It takes time for them to open up. Rather than pressing for answers, staying nearby lets them warm up on their own.

peer.name: Playful Bunny
peer.who: Someone comfortable who meets you eye to eye
peer.look: Round eyes, a neat little nose, and a bright smile greet you first.
peer.ease: They tend not to compare or keep score, meeting you at your level so you can just be yourself.
peer.care: The closer you get, the easier it is to blur lines. Naming shared expectations around time or money early on helps.

wealth.name: Bright Squirrel
wealth.who: Someone sharp who knows how to keep things in order
wealth.look: Sparkling, attentive eyes and slightly rounded cheeks give off a quick, capable impression.
wealth.ease: They manage daily life with care, bringing an orderly, dependable feel to the routine.
wealth.care: Being quick with practical details can sometimes read as calculating. Speaking your appreciation aloud clears up any misunderstanding.
